headline: Poundland management and MPs blame owner Gordon Brothers for collapse
summary: Poundland's management and MPs have blamed its US owner, Gordon Brothers, for the retailer's collapse. The US firm stated that without its backing, the chain would have collapsed last year.
why: Poundland is a prominent discount retail chain in the UK, and questions surrounding its corporate ownership and financial stability highlight pressures within high-street retail sectors.

impacts.name: Gordon Brothers
impacts.why: Management and MPs blamed the US owner for the retailer's collapse.
